versions.changelog:
- Initial release of seo-bing skill for Bing Webmaster Tools and IndexNow integration.
- Enables Bing visibility, link data retrieval, and IndexNow URL submission for improved Microsoft Copilot and search indexing.
- Supports comparison of Bing link data across properties and batch/individual URL submissions.
- Designed for sites seeking indexing on Bing-powered platforms (Amazon, Bing, Naver, Seznam.cz, Yandex, Yep).
- Requires a Bing Webmaster Tools API key; IndexNow key is optional.
